# In2ition Media

> In2ition Media is a web design studio in Georgetown, Guyana, founded by Shelroy Thomas. We design and hand-code custom websites (no page builders or templates) for hotels, tour operators, engineering firms and service businesses across Guyana, and offer SEO, hosting and care, and social media advertising.

- Location: 211 Albert St, Georgetown, Guyana
- Phone / WhatsApp: +592 692 2647
- Typical project budgets: GY$300,000 to GY$2,000,000+
- Google rating: 5.0 from client reviews

## Services

- [Website design in Guyana](https://in2ition.media/services/website-design-guyana/): custom, hand-coded websites built for phones and Google, with process, prices and FAQs
- [SEO services in Guyana](https://in2ition.media/services/seo-guyana/): technical and on-page SEO, Google Business Profile, structured data and content
- [Website hosting & care](https://in2ition.media/services/website-hosting-guyana/): hosting, backups, monitoring, updates and local support
- [Social media & ads](https://in2ition.media/services/social-media-ads-guyana/): Facebook and Instagram campaigns, content and conversion tracking
- [Hotel & tourism website design](https://in2ition.media/services/tourism-website-design-guyana/): booking-ready websites for hotels, guesthouses and tour operators
- [How much does a website cost in Guyana?](https://in2ition.media/blog/how-much-does-a-website-cost-in-guyana/): 2026 price guide in GYD

## Case studies

Full portfolio: https://in2ition.media/work/

- [Arctic Zone HVAC](https://in2ition.media/work/arctic-zone-hvac/): lead-generating website with a cooling-load estimator for a commercial and industrial HVAC contractor
- [Specom](https://in2ition.media/work/specom/): corporate website for a standby power engineering company and authorized agent of global power brands
- [Singing Chef Adventures](https://in2ition.media/work/singing-chef-adventures/): booking website for a food and culture tour guide in Georgetown
- [Service Guyana](https://in2ition.media/work/service-guyana/): website for a Georgetown HVAC and mechanical contractor and authorized Trane and Mitsubishi dealer
- [Ultimate Body Sculpting](https://in2ition.media/work/ultimate-body-sculpting/): booking-focused website for a non-surgical body sculpting and beauty studio
